overview: A modern, fully responsive, highly animated promotional website for SS Collection Nagpur — a multi-brand offline retail store selling Nike, Puma, and Reebok shoes, clothing, and sports gear. Features a dark theme with neon accents, glassmorphism, and Framer Motion animations throughout.
features: Hero section with animated gradient background and CTA buttons
Brand showcase with glow and scale-hover effects for Nike, Puma, Reebok
Product categories (Shoes, Clothing, Sports Gear) with distinct hover animations and discount badges
Masonry gallery with hover zoom overlay
Store locations section highlighting 6 branches across Nagpur, Chhattisgarh, and MP
Instagram social proof section with mock feed grid and 97K+ follower count
About and Footer sections with WhatsApp and Instagram links
Sticky navbar with animated mobile hamburger menu
Framer Motion scroll reveals, hover effects, ripple/glow buttons throughout
Fully responsive mobile-first design with glassmorphism and neon accents
